items.summary: Recommendation: retain both reversible LCP fixes, with no spending, telemetry changes, deployment authorization, or financial claims. Evidence: 2026-10-03 mobile LCP is 3501ms for aliencouncil.com and 3599ms for newmomshop.com; both are queue-eligible with no listed active-work conflict. Revenue claims remain unsupported: the 30-day Amazon window pulled 2026-10-02 reports 5.20 commission, 5,992 clicks, 31 ordered items, and 7 shipped items, but all commission is aggregate and unattributed, so site revenue is not calculable. Contribution margin is not calculable because attributable revenue, infrastructure/domain costs, labor costs, and complete AI allocation are absent. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because period-aligned attributable outcomes and labor time/rates are absent. AI usage from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-03 is $80.9743339 across 441 calls with 25 errors; the ledger covers 29 instrumented sites while the data-quality contract observes 28 of 40 expected sites. Budget exposure is not calculable because monthly spend, marketing, revenue, and fixed-cost limits are blank. Measure only LCP and deterministic quality gates; do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, causal lift, or forecast upside.
